singapore-2007.notes: Source 1 (http://www.comp.nus.edu.sg/~acmicpc) now serves the 2018 ICPC Asia Singapore Regional Contest site (belongs_to singapore-2018; it also links a /2015/ page, singapore-2015). Problem names from source 3 (catalogue has none): A MODEX, B JONES, C ACORN, D TUSK, E SKYLINE, F USHER, G RACING.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw captures of the NUS School of Computing general homepage; our copy now holds the 2018 regional's website (with a 2015 page), likewise nothing of the 2007 contest.
sources.evidence: The seed page is titled '2018 ICPC Asia Singapore Regional Contest' and the only other page is the '2015 ACM ICPC Asia Singapore Regional Contest' page; 2007 appears only in 'last held ICPC Asia Singapore back in 2015 and 2007' and in biographies.
PDF cover '2007 ACM Asia Programming Contest Singapore, 14 December 2007, Contest Problems' followed by Problem A: MODEX to Problem G: RACING.

singapore-2018.notes: Editorial (source 7) covers 9 of 12 problems; G, H, F are explicitly skipped. The QOJ page has no attachments.

sources.evidence: QOJ dashboard headed 'The 2018 ICPC Asia Singapore Regional Contest' listing problems A Largest Triangle to L Non-Prime Factors, matching the catalogue.
Slides titled 'Contest debriefing' with a result table for problems A to L and solution sections for J, C, L, B, A, D, K, I, E, whose names match the catalogue.
